programme.title: Gibby perd son sang froid
programme.desc: Gibby est persuadé que Freddie est intéressé par sa nouvelle petite amie. Il lui propose alors de le défier au cours d'un combat, que Sam décide de diffuser en direct dans l'émission de Carly.

programme.title: LAmour perdu de Lewbert
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent que Lewbert avait une petite amie et qu'il était heureux. Ils décident de retrouver Marta en espérant qu'elle lui apportera à nouveau le bonheur. Mais la vie n'est pas toujours comme on l'imagine...

programme.title: Le concours de beauté
programme.desc: Sam révèle à Carly et Freddie avoir participé à un concours de beauté lorsqu'elle était plus jeune.

programme.title: Le rendez-vous de Spencer
programme.desc: Sam se retrouve accidentellement en prison et Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour que l'émission ait lieu malgré tout. Ils demandent alors l'aide de Spencer, qui a malheureusement un rendez-vous ce soir là.

programme.title: dans lespace
programme.desc: iCarly se voit proposer de tourner un web show exceptionnel dans l'Espace grâce à un milliardaire qui souhaite promouvoir un nouveau concept de voyage spatial...

programme.title: Bigfoot
programme.desc: A la suite d'un reportage aux infos, Carly est bien décidée à prouver à tout le monde que BIGFOOT, un primate humanoïde, existe réellement.

programme.title: Freddie déménage!
programme.desc: Freddie ne supporte plus que ça mère le traite comme un bébé et déménage. Carly et Sam monte une affaire de photographie animalière, mais sont vite dérangées par d'autres photographes ne supportant pas la concurrence.

programme.title: Vague de chaleur
programme.desc: A cause de la vague de chaleur, la ville subit une panne de courant. Spencer, toujours plein da ressource, met en marche un générateur électrique et un climatiseur ultra performant.

programme.title: La psychopathe
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly doit se rendre au Webicône à Olympia, un festival qui réunit toutes les plus grandes stars du Web... Avant de partir, ils reçoivent un mail vidéo de Nora, une jeune fan désespérée et sans ami.

programme.title: La psychopathe
programme.desc: L'équipe d'iCarly doit se rendre au Webicône à Olympia, un festival qui réunit toutes les plus grandes stars du Web... Avant de partir, ils reçoivent un mail vidéo de Nora, une jeune fan désespérée et sans ami.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Miranda, l'actrice qui joue le rôle d'iCarly convoque Jerry, le comédien jouant Spencer sur le plateau pour lui remonter les bretelles.

programme.title: Lanniversaire de Carly
programme.desc: C'est l'anniversaire de Carly, Spencer veut lui faire un cadeau original. Il fabrique une lampe avec des bonbons qui prend feu. La chambre de Carly brûle entièrement. Grâce à l'argent de l'assurance,

programme.title: Je le veux
programme.desc: Carly reçoit une demande originale : Gordon, un fan de l'émission, veut demander la main de sa petite amie, Jodi, en direct. Jodi accepte la demande en mariage et convie Carly et ses amis au mariage!

programme.title: Cloudboy
programme.desc: Nila vient d'avoir douze ans, a toujours vécu en ville avec son père. Cet été, il se voit contraint de partir en vacances à la montagne dans le nord de la Suède avec sa mère qu'il ne connait presque pas.

programme.title: Tom Sawyer et Huckleberry Finn
programme.desc: Tom Sawyer et son ami Huckleberry Finn s'embarquent pour une incroyable aventure sur le fleuve Mississipi, se prenant pour des pirates, assistant à leurs propres funérailles puis devenant témoins d'un meurtre.

programme.title: La petite princesse et le dragon
programme.desc: Le jour de ses 7 ans, la Princesse Barbara découvre un livre magique qui la transporte dans un univers merveilleux rempli de créatures fantastiques.

programme.title: Au Secours ! J'ai rétréci mes amis
programme.desc: Pour protéger ses objets magiques, Otto Leonhard a enseigné à Félix l'art secret du rétrécissement. Ses amis ayant failli gâcher son rendez-vous avec Mélanie, Félix les réduit instantanément à un dixième de leur taille.

programme.title: Les Z'intrus
programme.desc: Un ado réalise sa destinée en menant frère, sœur et cousins dans une bataille contre des extraterrestres qui utilisent leur maison de vacances pour planifier une invasion.

programme.title: La loi de Brooklyn
programme.desc: Un ancien détenu se voit entraîné dans une brutale guerre de territoire avec la mafia Russe, ce qui le force à replonger dans son passé trouble afin d'utiliser les techniques de survie apprises dans l'une des plus violentes prisons.

programme.title: Blood Circus
programme.desc: Un ancien champion du monde de MMA se voit enrôlé dans un club de combat souterrain appelé « Blood Circus » et se retrouver forcé de se battre pour survivre et sauver sa famille.

programme.title: Red Right Hand
programme.desc: Cash essaie de mener une vie honnête et tranquille, en s'occupant de sa nièce Savannah dans les collines du comté d'Odim. Lorsque la sadique "Queenpin Big Cat", qui tient la ville sous sa coupe, lui réclame son aide, Cash apprend qu'il est capable de tout, même de tuer, pour protéger la ville et la seule famille qui lui reste.

programme.title: The Boy Behind the Door
programme.desc: Enlevés sur le chemin de l'école, Bobby et Kevin se retrouvent prisonniers d'un ravisseur impitoyable. Après une première évasion, Bobby décide de retourner sauver son ami lorsque surgit une menace encore plus dangereuse. Une course contre la montre où chaque décision peut être fatale.

programme.title: Dahmer le Cannibale
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie, Dahmer raconte l'histoire du célèbre serial-killer Jeffrey Dahmer.

programme.title: Force of execution
programme.desc: Un ténor du crime se retrouve face à un dilemme : continuer à accroître sa richesse ou arrêter ses activités souterraines pour reprendre une vie normale. Mais pendant ce temps, un nouveau criminel débarque en ville avec la ferme intention de le vaincre…

programme.title: Le projet Atticus
programme.desc: Fondé en 1976 par le Dr Henry West, l'Institut Atticus étudiait des capacités paranormales : parapsychologie, voyance... Des centaines de cas ont été étudiés, mais rien ne préparait l'équipe à Judith.

programme.title: Stage Fright
programme.desc: Bien décidée à suivre les pas de sa mère, ancienne diva de Broadway, Camilla passe un casting et décroche un rôle dans une pièce. Mais les répétitions tournent vite au bain de sang.

programme.title: Kidnapping Mr. Heineken
programme.desc: En 1983, Henry Heineken, petit-fils du fondateur de la marque, est kidnappé avec son chauffeur. Les ravisseurs demandent une rançon record de 35 millions de florins.

programme.title: La Cinémamecque
programme.desc: La Cinémamecque est une série de courts métrages en stop motion, une histoire du cinéma modelée, animée et analysée et un ciné-club.

programme.title: Diagnostic
programme.desc: Le Dr Semyc est un spécialiste d'une maladie très répandue pour laquelle il n'existe aucun traitement à ce jour. Annoncer le diagnostic est donc un exercice délicat qu'il maitrise cependant à la perfection.

programme.title: Split time
programme.desc: Un homme, une femme. La trentaine. Séduisants et rêveurs. Célibataires. Ils se croisent un milliards de fois sans se rencontrer. Ils sont pourtant faits l'un pour l'autre.

programme.title: Petite mort
programme.desc: Cinq hommes se confient et nous parlent de leurs expériences sexuelles.

programme.title: Le môme Tintouin
programme.desc: Le môme Tintouin est atteint d'un mal dont on n'a pas idée. Le moindre acte de la vie quotidienne est un problème. A l'intérieur de ce crâne fragile tout ne tient qu'à un fil. Les phobies, les voix intérieures dissonantes, le poussent dans ses derniers retranchements. La tendance est de dire qu'il travaille du chapeau mais de toute évidence, le môme Tintouin ne sait plus où donner de la tête.

programme.title: Je sens le beat qui monte en moi
programme.desc: Rosalba, jeune guide touristique, souffre d'une affection étrange : la moindre mélodie provoque chez elle gesticulation et danse de façon aussi subtile qu'incontrôlable. Malgré ses ruses pour cacher son excentricité, ce corps indomptable pourrait bien séduire son surprenant collègue Alain...

programme.title: Rocambolesque
programme.desc: Au milieu du XIXe siècle, face à un éditeur qui refuse obstinément de l'augmenter, que peut bien faire le jeune auteur Ponson du Terrail… si ce n'est mettre dans la balance le destin de Rocambole, le héros de son feuilleton quotidien ?

programme.title: 2 minutes 30
programme.desc: Syrie, 2011. Nour passe le soir de Noël dans un appartement d'Homs avec un groupe de journalistes. Cette jeune pigiste française manque d'argent et veut sortir pour travailler. Mais dehors, c'est la guerre

programme.title: Trop de bruits qui courent
programme.desc: Evry, novembre 2015, quelques jours après les attentats de Paris. Ryad, seize ans,« n'assume pas » sa copine Sabrina: il a honte de se montrer amoureux devant ses copains du quartier. Le vol d'une vidéo sur son portable va pourtant le pousser à changer.

programme.title: Belle à jamais
programme.desc: Ville : Yaoundé. Adresse : Etoudi, carrefour du palais. C'est en arrivant dans cette maison où j'allais vivre pendant cinq semaines que j'ai décidé de filmer ses habitants : Dolvie, Daniella, Gaelle, Mirabelle, Raphaella, Ingrid, Sophie et Loic. Tous vivent chez Honorine, mais seule Gaelle est sa « vraie » fille. Pourtant ici, tout le monde appelle Honorine « maman ».

programme.title: La table
programme.desc: Un menuisier perfectionniste est obsédé par l'idée de créer un objet idéal.

programme.title: Petit homme
programme.desc: En plein nuit, Marc part furieux au volant de sa voiture.

programme.title: Iceberg
programme.desc: M. Elys travaille depuis vingt ans dans une patinoire où il a élu domicile. Il mène une vie sans but au volant de sa surfateuse à glace. Jusqu'au jour où il se heurte à Brie, une gamine farouche et obstinée.Il va lui ouvrir les portes de la patinoire sans se douter des conséquences.

programme.title: Ce qui nous éloigne
programme.desc: Après une longue séparation, une rencontre. Deux familles. Un enfant.

programme.title: Flirt
programme.desc: Quentin et son meilleur ami, Antoine, entrent en classe de troisième. Quentin a une copine. Chloé. Celle-ci ne laisse pas insensible Thomas, le petit caïd du collège. Le monde de l'enfance se fissure définitivement pour Quentin.

programme.title: De l'esprit d'équipe
programme.desc: Plongée documentaire au sein de “Pro Spectre”, l'entreprise de chasseurs de fantômes de Gilles et Joël.

programme.title: Taupes
programme.desc: Un groupe de gangsters est poursuivi après avoir dérobé un fabuleux trésor. Alors qu'ils s'enfoncent et s'égarent dans une mystérieuse forêt, ils deviennent peu à peu des figures légendaires...

programme.title: Mazeppa
programme.desc: Johan, un pianiste doué mais peu sûr de lui, s'apprête à passer un important concours musical. Submergé par le stress, il se réfugie dans les toilettes des filles où il fait la connaissance d'une jeune femme qui lui offre un tout autre destin.

programme.title: Elikia
programme.desc: Elikia, l'histoire d'un jeune homme accablé par son quotidien désastreux qui décide de se lancer dans la danse suite à sa rencontre avec Gabrielle.

programme.title: The eXtremists
programme.desc: Une équipe de tournage se rend dans les Alpes autrichiennes, près de l'ancienne frontière yougoslave, pour filmer trois passionnés de sports extrêmes poursuivis par une avalanche pour une publicité. Ce qu'ils ignorent, c'est qu'ils tournent à proximité de la cachette secrète de Slobodan Pavle, un criminel de guerre serbe. L'ayant accidentellement filmé, ils se retrouvent entraînés dans une course-poursuite mortelle à travers les montagnes, mêlant ski, snowboard, parachutisme, rafting, hélicoptères, motos et base jump.

programme.title: Rescue Team
programme.desc: Sur une ile Asiatique, une équipe de scientifiques étudie la récente apparition d'un virus mortel. Ce dernier prend la forme d'une maladie dégénérescente et les habitants locaux en sont les premières victimes. Après avoir découvert l'existence d'un « elixir de vie », les scientifiques vont disparaitre en laissant derrière eux un message d'alerte concernant cette terrible maladie qui se propage rapidement. Les forces armées internationales et des mercenaires prêts à tout, débarquent sur l'ile avec un enjeu majeur, la survie de l'humanité pour certains mais surtout de nombreux intérêts personnels.

programme.title: Termination Point
programme.desc: Le scientifique à l'origine du projet secret de téléportation et de voyage dans le temps du gouvernement part avec celui-ci dans un avion de ligne lorsque le gouvernement décide de le militariser.

programme.title: American Ninja 5
programme.desc: Lorsque la fille d'un scientifique est kidnappée, American Ninja (David Bradley) tente de la retrouver, mais cette fois-ci, il fait équipe avec un jeune qu'il a formé aux techniques du ninja.

programme.title: Les cinq gentlemen maudits
programme.desc: A Tanger, un sorcier prédit, à cinq amis, une mort certaine et rapide. Trois d'entre eux auront déjà trouvé la mort quand les deux autres résoudront l'énigme.

programme.title: Wolves
programme.desc: Un jeune homme se transforme en loup-garou après avoir été injustement accusé du meurtre de ses parents. Il se réfugie alors à Lupine Ridge, une petite ville où il découvrira le secret entourant sa propre identité.

programme.title: Rupture
programme.desc: Renee Morgan vit avec son fils de 12 ans dans une banlieue américaine tranquille. Alors qu'elle fait banalement ses courses, elle est violemment kidnappée et se retrouve, 24h plus tard, attachée et interrogée sur sa phobie des araignées dans un laboratoire vide et anonyme. Les scientifiques, plutOt menaçants, lui expliquent que cette phobie pourrait lui permettre d'atteindre le niveau de « rupture » nécessaire à sa mutation…

programme.title: Poisson D'avril
programme.desc: Emile, un mécanicien apprécié mais un brin naïf, se laisse convaincre par un vendeur insistant et lui achète un attirail de pêche. Préférant cacher cette dépense déraisonnable à sa femme, Emile s'éclipse pour tester le matériel chez une cousine, Annette. Une série de quiproquos improbables les obligent à prétendre que tous deux forment un couple.

programme.title: Ad Astra
programme.desc: L'astronaute Roy McBride s'aventure jusqu'aux confins du système solaire à la recherche de son père disparu et pour résoudre un mystère qui menace la survie de notre planète.

programme.title: Miss Bala
programme.desc: Après la disparition de son amie à Tijuana, Gloria Meyer se retrouve au centre d'un jeu dangereux joué par la CIA, la DEA et un chef de gang.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Clean, un homme au passé criminel, cherche la rédemption après avoir vécu une tragédie personnelle. Il dédie désormais sa vie à sa communauté délaissée et à la sécurité d'une jeune fille qui lui rappelle sa propre fille.

programme.title: Harvey Milk
programme.desc: Le film retrace les huit dernières années de la vie d'Harvey Milk. Dans les années 70, il fut le premier homme politique américain ouvertement gay à être élu à des fonctions officielles, à San Francisco en Californie ...

programme.title: L'Amour sous le citronnier
programme.desc: Licenciée, la photographe Becka tente un concours à Serenity Island. Elle y aide Josh, un fermier réticent.

programme.title: Dans l'enfer de la captivité
programme.desc: Mai 1977, Janice et Cameron prennent une auto-stoppeuse nommée Colleen dans leur voiture et la kidnappent,

programme.title: Avoir et à tenir
programme.desc: Après être tombée amoureuse de Joe, un jeune homme riche , Alice apprend qu'il est loin d'être parfait.

programme.title: Poursuite au bout du Far West
programme.desc: D'après une histoire vraie incroyable. Dans ce western épique, Poursuite au bout du Far West, Bass Reeves est à la poursuite d'un dangereux hors-la-loi et rêve de devenir le premier marshal noir du Far West. Avec Ron Perlman dans le rôle de son fidèle compagnon de route.

programme.title: Deux pécheresses et un chasseur de prime
programme.desc: Dans ce western palpitant, deux femmes non conformistes prennent la route et rencontrent un chasseur de primes blessé, et elles décident de l'aider à traquer sa proie pour se partager la récompense

programme.title: Catch the Bullet
programme.desc: Dans ce puissant western avec Peter Facinelli (Twilight), un marshall américain part à la recherche de son fils, kidnappé par un hors-la-loi vengeur, mais se retrouve sur le dangereux territoire des Sioux.

programme.title: Aviator
programme.desc: Un biopic illustrant les premières années de la carrière légendaire du réalisateur et aviateur Howard Hughes, de la fin des années 1920 au milieu des années 1940.

programme.title: Borrego
programme.desc: Après avoir été témoin du crash de l'avion d'une mule dans le désert de Borrego, Elly est kidnappée et obligée de faire un dangereux voyage vers un point de chute éloigné.

programme.title: Lady Gun Fighter
programme.desc: Une mère prend sur elle et s'aventure dans la rude frontière pour retrouver son fils dérobé.

programme.title: La Loi du campus
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves, Kiefer Sutherland et Billy Zane interprètent des lycéens qui forment une milice pour combattre le crime dans leur quartier. Mais à mesure que leur pouvoir augmente, ils deviennent de plus en plus violents et dangereux.

programme.title: Staying Alive
programme.desc: Cela fait cinq ans que le Staying Alive de Tony Manero fait toujours autant fureur. Il se approche maintenant nonchalamment de son plus grand défi : le produire sur la scène de Broadway.

programme.desc: Découvrez le classement des bandes annonces de vos films et séries préférés.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: Deux voleurs découvrent un sombre secret en cambriolant une maison et doivent affronter un tueur redoutable.

programme.title: Rememory
programme.desc: La mort suspecte de Gordon, créateur de la machine Rememory, lance une enquête pour percer le mystère.

programme.title: Crypto
programme.desc: Un jeune banquier de Wall Street, rétrogradé dans sa ville natale, découvre un réseau de corruption.

programme.title: Ce que veulent les femmes
programme.desc: Nick Marshall est LE macho à l'américaine! La clope au bec, toujours bien rasé, les abdos hyper dessinés, ce qu'il faut de poils, un regard à tomber par terre, et bien sûr le sourire éclatant laissant entrevoir ses dents d'une blancheur étincelante.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Un petit confiseur est furieux de découvrir qu'une grande entreprise de confiserie s'installe dans les environs. Mais tout se complique lorsqu'une romance improbable naît avec sa nouvelle concurrente.

programme.title: November Criminals
programme.desc: Deux amis bientôt étudiants universitaires (Ansel Elgort et Chloë Grace Moretz) tombent amoureux l'un de l'autre. Mais après le meurtre mystérieux de leur camarade de classe, ils défient les autorités de découvrir la vérité.

programme.title: Apartment 12
programme.desc: Un artiste de Los Angeles voit sa vie basculer lorsque son exposition d'art est annulée et que sa petite-amie mannequin le quitte.

programme.title: L'amour d'une mère
programme.desc: Mariée et mère de famille, Laney mène en apparence une vie paisible. Mais c'est sans compter sur la drogue, les rencontres avec d'autres hommes et son habitude de disparaitre sans prévenir.

programme.title: L'envie
programme.desc: Deux voisins, également très bons amis, voient leurs relations se détériorer, lorsque l'un d'entre eux devient riche en commercialisant son invention. L'autre va alors envier sa fortune.

programme.title: Pour de mauvaises raisons
programme.desc: An ensemble film about four everyday people: a store manager, a security guard, a fire fighter and a clerk who struggle in the aftermath of trauma.

programme.title: La messagère
programme.desc: Après avoir frôlé la mort, Ellie Daly est terrifiée de réaliser qu'elle est capable de voir et de parler avec les morts. De retour chez elle, elle est abordée par le fantôme furieux d'une femme morte, qui accuse le mystérieux et séduisant nouveau voisin d'Ellie de son propre meurtre brutal.

programme.title: Un Noël de Roman
programme.desc: La romancière cynique Dru Cassadine, connue pour ses histoires d'amour, cherche désespérément à percer après une série d'échecs. Poussée par des critiques brutales et la menace de son éditeur de la laisser tomber, elle n'a que quelques semaines pour écrire un best-seller.

programme.title: Oxygen
programme.desc: Deux gars kidnappent la femme d'un homme riche et l'enterrent dans une boîte avec 24 heures d'oxygène.

programme.title: Lizzie
programme.desc: Une adaptation de l'histoire de Lizzie Borden, accusée du double meurtre de son père et de sa belle-mère.

programme.title: Le Casse-Coeur
programme.desc: En plein cambriolage dans une maison, harry rencontre daisy et décide de la sauver d'elle-même.

programme.title: Darkweb
programme.desc: Un couple de vidéastes organise des parties de chasse pour les millionnaires en quête de sensations fortes.

programme.title: Chevalier
programme.desc: Bien qu'il ne soit pas noble et donc qu'il n'ait pas le droit de participer aux joutes des chevaliers, l'intrépide William décide de prendre son destin en main en remplaçant au pied levé le seigneur dont il est l'écuyer, décédé tragiquement quelques jours avant le fameux tournoi qui doit réunir tous les chevaliers du territoire.

programme.title: Peggy Sue S'est Mariee
programme.desc: Nominé pour trois Oscars, y compris l'Oscar de la meilleure actrice, Peggy Sue s'est mariée met en scène Kathleen Turner dans le rôle de Peggy Sue Bodell, une jolie mère enjouée qui a deux enfants et qui s'est récemment séparée de son mari (Nicolas Cage). Seule, elle va à la 25ème réunion des anciens du lycée, s'évanouit et se retrouve au même endroit qu'en 1959.

programme.title: Drinking Buddies
programme.desc: Kate (Olivia Wilde) et Luke (Jake Johnson) travaillent ensemble dans une micro-brasserie. Leur amitié donne l'impression qu'elle pourrait mener à bien plus encore, mais voilà : Kate est avec Chris (Ron Livingston) et Luke est avec Jill (Anna Kendrick) qui veut savoir s'il est prêt à parler mariage. La réponse à cette question devient limpide quand Luke et Kate se retrouvent seuls pour un week-end ensemble. « Ivresse entre Amis» est écrit et réalisé par Joe Swanberg et met en vedette Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson, Anna Kendrick et Ron Livingston.

programme.title: Holmes and Watson
programme.desc: Une version humoristique des enquêtes classiques de Sir Arthur Conan Doyle mettant en vedette Sherlock Holmes et le docteur Watson.

programme.title: Borat, nouvelle mission filmée
programme.desc: Dans cette suite hilarante, le quatrième meilleur journaliste du Kazakhstan, Borat Sagdiyev, doit offrir un "cadeau" au vice-président américain.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes & John Watson
programme.desc: Les frangins malgré eux se retrouvent. Cette fois, ils interprètent le plus grand détective du monde et son fidèle acolyte et biographe. Will Ferrell et John C. Reilly jouent Holmes et Watson. Ensemble, ils élucident un meurtre à Buckingham Palace.

programme.title: Art School Confidential

programme.title: Sam Thompson On His Anxiety And Undiagnosed ADHD
programme.desc: Sam Thompson discusses how anxiety and undiagnosed ADHD have shaped his relationships and self-confidence. He shares his experience of panic attacks, including one on the first day of I'm A Celebrity, and talks about therapy, the patterns he kept repeating, and his three go-to people during crises. Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: Chris Appleton: From Being Bullied to Styling the Kardashians
programme.desc: Celebrity hair stylist Chris Appleton chats with Fearne about why we change our hair when we want to start over. Chris explains that everyone from the Kardashians to cancer patients have opened up to him about their insecurities, and he's seen the profound impact that looking more like yourself on the outside can have on how you feel about yourself on the inside. He's fascinated by the self-limiting beliefs people have about who they are. Chris has dealt with a lot of his own shame and fears too. He was bullied at school, struggled to acknowledge his sexuality, and had huge imposter syndrome when he first arrived in Hollywood. He also gives Fearne a consultation about going bolder with her hair. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicidal ideation.

programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

programme.title: Nafessa Williams On Racism, Sexism, and Rivals
programme.desc: Rivals actress Nafessa Williams discusses playing the only black woman in a white man's world in 1980s Britain, and how she sees her acting as her contribution to activism and representation. She explores what it means to be on a TV show with intimate scenes, the journey from law to acting, manifestation and taking action, faith and optimism, and the importance of rest alongside ambition.

programme.title: Carol Vorderman Talks Politics, Education, and Parenting
programme.desc: Broadcaster Carol Vorderman discusses her early life, from her family running away with the circus and living out of a car, to being one of the first girls to read engineering at Cambridge University. She reveals who wrote her first application to Countdown and explains why everything about our lives is political, from the pressure put on kids and parents by schools to women's bodily autonomy.

programme.title: Poorna Bell On How To Put Yourself First
programme.desc: Award-winning journalist and author Poorna Bell joins Fearne to talk about ageing, ambition, marriage, motherhood, grief and the quiet rage that can build when women feel invisible. From challenging the narrative that women "disappear" in midlife, to questioning the myth of "having it all", this conversation is about reclaiming agency, on your own terms.

programme.title: Gerry Adams on Palestine, a United Ireland, and His Awakening
programme.desc: Gerry Adams, one of the most significant political figures of the last fifty years, speaks to PoliticsJOE about his political awakening, Palestine, a united Ireland, and the future of Irish politics. In a conversation days before Andy Burnham's coronation and days after the burning of nationalist effigies on bonfires across his hometown, Adams discusses the necessary next steps for Burnham's government, how to quell the rise of the far-right, and how to prepare for the end of the union with Britain. Topics include Irish unity, sectarianism, the far-right and racism on the streets, loyalist paramilitaries, the Jeffrey Donaldson scandal, media bias, and his father's IRA past.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: Devina A.D.D. & The Relationship Virgin
programme.desc: It's a new week at the Millionaire's Club and that means two tough new clients for matchmaker, Patti Stanger. Author Devina Kaur is a sex crazed dating addict who's obsessed with hooking up with men on Craigslist. And Peter Curti, a gay millennial entrepreneur with his head buried in his phone, has never had a real relationship. Devina proves to be a challenge right out of the gate, matching Patti scream for scream. All of her outbursts leave Patti wondering if Devina has come to the Millionaire's Club just because she's run out of men on the internet. And when Patti throws a test into the mingle, Devina A.D.D. unsurprisingly fails miserably and earns a matchmaker punishment. It's a crap-shoot whether this wild and crazy Canadian will finally listen to Patti and find true love or revert to searching Craigslist for men. Meanwhile, relationship virgin Peter, is thrown into his love lesson. When confronted with his anti-social behavior, he argues with Patti, even telling her she's too old to understand. A generation gap Is obvious but Patti knows that dealing with millennials and their tech obsession requires an adjustment in tactics. Peter needs to learn to ditch his phone, pull his eyes up and learn to approach men like an alpha or he'll end up alone!

programme.title: Mr. Build-A-Girl and The Basketball Wife
programme.desc: This week it's a full-on, knock-down, drag-out fight between Patti Stanger and her two combative clients! Tough girl Basketball Wives LA tv star, Laura Govan, was majorly burned by her NBA star boyfriend of 17 years. Their nasty and highly publicized breakup left Laura alone with their four kids and with major trust issues. Patti's hidden cameras catch Laura in the act of some shocking behaviors that Laura uses to keep men away from her heart. If Laura wants to find a good man and potential stepfather to her four kids, she has to change her offensive deflecting behavior, or she'll remain single. Meanwhile, Bastian Yotta is obsessed with working out, his good looks and wants a woman who is equally as “perfect”. Patti calls Bastian out for being a “build-a-girl” after discovering that he will do will do anything to improve a woman's looks, even suggest and pay for their surgical enhancements. His superficial mentality prevents chemistry from taking over and Patti is forced give him one of her toughest reality checks ever to try and shake him of his perfectionism. At the mingle, it's Patti vs Bastian in a heated altercation after he insults the looks of one of her daters. And Laura and Bastian's dates go off the rails when one goes for a colon cleanse and the other instigates a private bikini fashion show. Both clients get the wrath of Patti, but will that be enough to help them get on the right path to true love?

programme.title: The Ageist and The Snob
programme.desc: Third generation matchmaker Patti Stanger is back and better than ever! She's taken over the exclusive Luxe Hotel in Bel-Air where she brings her toughest clients for a week-long lesson in love. This week, Patti is on the case with two tough lawyers: the ageist, David Goldman, and the first-class snob, Rhonda Wills. Right out of the gate, David jumps head first into a love lesson that he fails miserably when he ditches his age-appropriate date for a romp in the pool with a bunch of 20-somethings. Meanwhile, Patti struggles to convince Snobby Pants Rhonda to give up on her fairytale fantasy of Prince Charming. Patti, Candace, and Maxwell team up to find the perfect sexy singles for the mingle, but Patti throws the ageist David another curve ball when she adds a 22-year-old to the mix to test him. Will he fall for it and break Patti's rules or has he learned his lesson? Rhonda, on the other hand, meets a knight in shining armor. But… will she try to escape when he fails to deliver a fairytale first date. In the end, Patti's got a tough week. Will the lawyers learn their lesson or will it be a hung jury?

programme.title: Little Lovebird & Mr. Know-It-All
programme.desc: This season, Patti Stanger faces the toughest of the tough cases and this week is no exception. Jersey native, Jason Karniol is a poker playing ticket broker who thinks he knows everything. He takes his poker skills into his dating life and actually reads women's “tells”, dismissing them immediately. He performs true-to-type during his love lesson and infuriates Patti by insisting his methods work. Yelling and insults start flying and Patti lays down the law. Jason must stop his ridiculous “Forget-About-It Frank” behavior and get to know women before judging them. But old habits die hard and Jason struggles to follow Patti's rules. Meanwhile, little person Kacy McInturff from “Little Weddings” fame has only known bootie call love her entire adult life. And no one has ever told her they love her… ever! At 39, she feels the clock is ticking and wedding planner, Kacy needs to decide if she'll follow Patti demands, no matter how painful, in order to change the course of her life. Kacy needs to learn how to demand monogamy in her relationship. But this little lovebird has a habit of returning to her old familiar nest regardless of how much she wants things to change. The bobby, of course, has disappeared by the time Gladys Kravitz brings her husband to see him. At the rally, the Mayor tells his constituents a traffic light is unnecessary. programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, even the rarest – some of the most iconic creatures in the natural world. Many are familiar but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers.

programme.title: Monkey Mayhem
programme.desc: Monkeys: loveable, aggressive, diverse and full of mischief. Our distant cousins have much in common with us. They're intelligent, cooperative and have complex relationships. They're some of the most evolutionary successful species on the planet, successful across the globe from Japanese snow monkeys to African baboons. Swinging through our family tree quickly reveals the diversity of our monkey relatives. They come in all shapes and sizes, and are certainly not as different from us as we might think.

programme.title: Project Tiger
programme.desc: “Project Tiger” is the largest and most ambitious conservation project in history. Its success is celebrated around the world, but until now the full story has remained hidden. Marking “Project Tiger's” 50th Anniversary this documentary offers intimate wildlife sequences with rare insight into the tigers' personal world and the ancient forests where they thrive, while unique access to never-before-seen undercover footage reveals the shocking truths of multi-national wildlife crime networks. Set against the backdrop of India's extraordinary growth and transformation, this incredible story is told in full for the first time by the people who have lived and breathed the traumas and the triumphs of five decades of tiger conservation in India.

programme.title: Polar Bear Family
programme.desc: The ultimate icons of polar wilderness, able to withstand the harshest environments and remain a top predator the lives of polar bears are nothing short of remarkable!

programme.title: Manatees on the Move
programme.desc: Manatees, sea cows, these gentle giants go by several names. They were once thought to be beautiful mermaids that could lure sailors to their deaths, though they probably won't win too many beauty contests. To retain their weight, manatees need to eat for 8 hours and consume 8% of their bodyweight every day. And keeping eating also means keeping moving! Thanks to their tolerance of human visitors, manatees have mates everywhere, working tirelessly to ensure they roam the world for generations to come.

programme.title: Cheetah: Beating the Odds
programme.desc: A cheetah raises her young family on the vast expanse of the Serengeti. If her cubs are going to survive, she'll have to overcome a barrage of challenges. Lions, gangsters of the plains, are quick to throw their muscle around, whilst hyenas and jackals attempt to steal anything the cheetah manage to kill. The cheetah will have to learn the hunting skills their mother has perfected. Once they've learnt the ropes, they'll make their own way across the plains, establishing territory and having cubs of their own.

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, even the rarest – some of the most iconic creatures in the natural world. Many are familiar but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: We travel by train from the westernmost point of mainland Europe up to Portugal's only national park, the Peneda-Gerês, and from lively Porto to the Spanish border in the northeast. The train takes you from the blue sea to the green Douro Valley, from the urban metropolis to the scorching heat of the deserted hinterland.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: Switzerland or Spain? This question is often asked by those who see pictures from northern Spain for the first time: High mountains, lonely villages, but - this is the crucial difference - also breathtaking Atlantic beaches. The "Costa Verde", the green coast, is a piece of Spain that is so different from the general tourist image of the Germans' favorite vacation destination. This area has been spared from mass tourism. We travel by train from Bilbao in the Basque Country to Santander in Cantabria and Asturias.

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Survival of the Fittest in the Alps
programme.desc: The documentary shows the survival strategies of various animal species in the high mountains of the Alps in winter. Despite freezing temperatures and limited food supply, chamois, red deer and snow hares manage to survive the cold months. Latest research reveals the amazing abilities the animals have developed to adapt to the extreme conditions and also how climate change is altering the behaviour of the alpine inhabitants.

programme.title: Wild Sex
programme.desc: Sex is at the heart of everything. It's the only real way of leaving a legacy - in the genes of the future. But there's more than just the act - it's the build up to it when wildlife shows its incredible diversity. It drives touching courtships and fierce battles. Hormones and sex drive are forces that shape behaviour and can change an animal's purpose and persona. This is the story of how wild things get sexy. Without sex, there's nothing. It's a driving force throughout nature. The act of sex is mostly to make babies, but let's face it, its foreplay that really counts - it brings out the best and the worst in the animal kingdom. Pre-coital courtship can give pleasure, but also gives the participants the chance to check each other out and make sure they've found the perfect match. It affects us all. Birds do it, bees do it, all the way through the animals kingdom. From fire flies who mix up their own chemistry sets to fill the forest with mood lighting, to mayflies that emerge on mass, by the millions to mate. Their vast orgies attract predators of all sizes. Fish risk their lives climbing rivers from the sea, and a barrage of bears and other predators - just for sex - but the mission is so strenuous it kills them, as soon as their eggs are laid, they wither and die. Sex and the hormones that drive it can turn cute and cuddly into a sex beast. It turns out the koala is a sex maniac, more into rape than romance. Many mammals, from guanaco (wild llama) to hippos chase, wrestle and bite their way to a romantic interlude. Huge male red Kangaroos even box. When it comes to wild sex, mammals are amazing, but its birds that are the real show stoppers. From dazzling peacocks to booming bustards, fighting turkeys to dancing birds of paradise, birds go all out on foreplay - though you sometimes have to wonder if it's worth it - after all that parading their sex is over in seconds There's a lot of effort for very little reward.

With his friend, Spanish chef, Chele Gonzalez, they embark on an anthropological exploration tracing how the ancestral varietal cacao (crillio) came to be in the Philippine islands. Visiting farms to mystical islands, to top kitchens in Manila, this is the ‘never-before-told' tale of cacao in the Philippine islands.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie
programme.desc: Vietnam offers travelers a wide range of exotic as well as simple homegrown grub. Sashi rolls into town with no knowledge of Vietnamese cuisine, and he gets an indepth street food 101 tour of the city. From learning about haute Franco-Vietnamese cuisine with the city's best French chefs, to a simple and honest bowl of pho. In this episode, Sashi uncovers the bustling city of Hanoi and all its trappings. Secret alleyways leading to decades old cafes offering famous brews like egg coffee to iconic places that serve French style baguettes and everything in between!

programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We're here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they're going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they're all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let's see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We've got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan's Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We've got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They're going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other's strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let's find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world's strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we'll find out.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry Shortcake is planning a first birthday party for her sister Apple Dumpling, so she sets off on an adventure to find the perfect party supplies (juice, cookies, a cake and party hats) and makes five new friends (Orange Blossom, Angel Cake, Ginger Snap, Honey Pie Pony and Huckleberry) along the way

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. She forgets, however, to check the sign-up sheet at the Café and schedules it for the same night as Blueberry is scheduled to read to the baby Berrykins. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Her vision is to have the girls model her fashions in a parade past the town fountain. What she didn't realize is that the Berrykins are turning the fountain into a big water show. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers. With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: A tale that will take you back in the past, EK Tha Raja Thi Rani is a dramatic take on the life of royalty. The story revolves around the head of the royal family Ameerkot. The family is headed by a woman, who portrays royalty in all her words and actions. Rajmata wishes the pride and the royalty of her family to always soar up in the sky. In this episode, she is seen eagerly waiting for her son, Rana Indravadhan to arrive home. He is a soldier who had taken part in the World War 2. The scene shifts to Rana Indravadhan, who visits his home. He has visions of the war and how he lost his fellow men in the war. Keep watching Ek Tha Raja Ek Tha Rani to learn more about his tale.Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal, but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Rana Indravadhan's procession is on the streets where people are eager to watch him. Just like them, Ayatri too wants to watch Rana. She, along with her mother, goes to the terrace to watch Rana. A flower pot obstructs Gayatri's vision, due to which she is unable to watch Rana's procession. In the eagerness to watch Ran, Gayatri accidentally drops the pot and it falls before Rana's procession. Hearing the thud, the horses, leading the procession, lose control and go wild. Rana manages to get the horses under control. The guards guarding Rana decide to search the house from where the pot has fallen. Gayatri on the other hand does not allow the guards to search the house. Each episode presents a standalone, fast-paced narrative inspired by passion-driven murders and intense criminal mysteries. The focus goes beyond the crime itself, uncovering the psychological conflicts and fatal decisions that lead to irreversible consequences.

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI FROM SACHKHAND SRI HARMANDIR SAHIB, AMRITSAR
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Desi Beatz
programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today's Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.desc: Koh Ae-rin, a mom that quit her job a long time ago, starts looking for a job to make a living when her husband suddenly passes away. While doing something no one asked her to at her new job, she finds out a secret of the Korean office of Cornerstone, an international military industrial complex. She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam

Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.
